messages:
Maya (PM): Hey all — Vanguard (customer) asked for a short deployment review next week to walk through Dedicated capacity, VPC peering, and KMS setup. Can we do a 30m slot? Wed or Thu morning PT preferred. Proposed agenda below.

Kevin (Eng Lead): Wed 10:30 PT or Thu 9:30 PT works for me. Who from infra/sales should join?

Oliver (Solutions Eng): I can join both, prefer Wed. Recommend Vanguard provide a list of expected traffic (rps, seq lengths) so we can pick instance sizes.

Sara (SRE): Wed 10:30 PT is fine. Quick checklist for the call: VPC CIDR & peering consent, SG egress rules, KMS key ARN, audit log ingestion point, model version pin. I can run through runbook.

Maya (PM): Great — locking Wed 10:30 PT unless someone flags a conflict. Attendees: Maya, Kevin, Sara, Oliver, + Vanguard eng (I'll invite). Agenda (30m):
1) 5m intros & success criteria from Vanguard
2) 10m Dedicated capacity sizing & autoscale settings
3) 7m Network & security (VPC peering, SGs, routes, KMS)
4) 5m Rollout plan & smoke tests (canary percent, fallback)
5) 3m Action items & owners

Maya (PM): Quick pre-read: https://www.internal.redwood/example/vanguard-deploy (please skim). Also please review the proposed config snippet below and flag anything missing before the call:
```
# proposed redwood Dedicated config
capacity:
  reserved_gpus: 8
  burst_pool: 2
autoscale:
  target_rps: 120
  min_nodes: 1
  max_nodes: 6
networking:
  vpc_peering: true
  allowed_cidrs: ["10.20.0.0/16"]
kms:
  key_arn: "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01"
model:
  name: "redwood/llm-medium-v2"
  pinned_version: "2026-02-15"
```

Kevin (Eng Lead): Couple of quick asks to add to agenda: ensure we review fallback model variants (quantized) for degraded capacity, and confirm logging/metrics export (datadog path).

Sara (SRE): I'll prepare the runbook checklist and include the smoke-test curl snippet. Will also verify whether Vanguard needs an AWS role for cross-account access or just peering.

Oliver (Solutions Eng): I'll confirm expected model footprint (mem/kv cache) and bring a short cost/latency tradeoff slide.

Maya (PM): Vanguard POC: jen@vanguard.com and alex@vanguard.com. I'll send calendar invite once we confirm Wed 10:30 PT. Please add any other agenda items here.

deploy-bot: Meeting created in calendar: "Vanguard - Dedicated Deployment Review" • Wed 10:30 PT • Maya (organizer) • link: https://calendar.internal/event/abcd

Kevin (Eng Lead): Ack — added. Can someone drop the smoke test we plan to run in the thread before the call so Vanguard can validate access?

Sara (SRE): Will do. Quick preview of smoke test: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.internal/v1/generate?model=redwood/llm-medium-v2` — expect 200 + tokens in <500ms for baseline.

Maya (PM): Thanks — seeing no objections. Wed 10:30 PT is set. I'll post final invite + pre-read reminder tomorrow. :thumbsup:
